scope: Independent published-point audit of the 64 active destinations; active coordinates and route geometries are not modified.
precisionPolicy: Coordinates may describe a landmark or area. Digits in a source do not establish positional accuracy, an entrance, vehicle access, or safe final-approach navigation.
matchingPolicy: Explicit identities were matched to 13 official pilgrimage-registry rows, 16 UNESCO serial-nomination components and the separate Chilpik nomination; unmatched exact claims remain unverified.
